listing.name: WH Rogue Trader Portrait Pack V1.0
listing.summary: This mod adds over 40 portraits from the game Warhammer 40k: Rogue Trader, playable characters, companions and some of the major characters, in addition to that there are also 3 portraits from the concept art of the game 40k Darktide.
listing.aiSummary: Adds over 80 Warhammer 40k-themed portraits and 10 officer chatter personalities for use in Starsector.

description:
Companions of the Imperium

Mods required for non-portrait content:

Combat Chatter

Citizens of the Imperium REJOICE! From this day onward you can spread the light of the God Emperor to the sector! Be it alone or with your trusty seneschal Abelard at your side!

This portrait pack currently contains over 80 different portraits for people to choose from within the Warhammer Universe. Many of the human portraits are introduced to the various vanilla factions of the game, while the alien/admech/ai portraits are currently only available to be used by the player. With update 1.2 this mod also introduces 10 officer chatter personalities for the people using the

Combat Chatter

mod.

Over time, i hope to expand this portrait pack to include portraits from other 40k game titles and potentially even book illustrations from Games Workshop. At the same time, the scope of the mod is currently expanding to also include more officer personalities to work with the Combat Chatter mod and might eventually lead to fully Unique officers.

Any feedback or even requests would be appreciated!

Changelog

Spoiler

## V1.1.0 ##
* Update for Starsector 0.98a
* Reworked all existing portraits
* Added over 40 new portraits

## v1.2.0 (2025-12-05) ##
* Added 10 new combat chatter personalities: Abelard. Idira, Yrliet, Heinrix, Pasqal, Cassia, Marazhai, Ulfar, Argenta, Jae.
* Renamed the mod into "Companions of the Imperium" to reflect its increasing scope.
